howItWorks.title: How to Upscale an Image
howItWorks.description: Upscale with AI in three simple steps:

step1.title: 1. Upload your image
step1.description:
Drag and drop or select your image file.

Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC formats.

step2.title: 2. Choose upscale settings
step2.description:
Select your preferred scale:

  • 2x – Double the resolution
  • 4x – Quadruple the resolution
  • 8x – Maximum enhancement (up to 16K output)

Choose a mode:

  • Fast Upscale – Preserves original details
  • Creative Upscale – Adds AI-generated details

step3.title: 3. Generate and download
step3.description:
Click Start and get your upscaled image in seconds.

Download in high resolution, ready to use.

q1.question: What image formats are supported?
q1.answer: We support JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC. If upload fails, try converting to JPG or PNG.

q2.question: What's the maximum output resolution?
q2.answer: You can upscale up to 16K (16384 × 16384) depending on input size and scale.

q3.question: What's the difference between Fast and Creative mode?
q3.answer: Fast enlarges faithfully—best for products/screenshots. Creative adds AI details—best for AI art or old photos.

q4.question: Can I upscale multiple images at once?
q4.answer: Yes. Batch processing lets you upload and upscale multiple images in one session.

q5.question: Will my upscaled images have a watermark?
q5.answer: No. All downloads are watermark-free and ready for use.

q6.question: Is my data safe and private?
q6.answer: Yes. Images are processed in isolated, encrypted sessions and deleted after processing. We never store or train on your uploads.

q7.question: What kind of images work best?
q7.answer: Clear, well-lit images produce the best results. Very low-quality inputs may still show some artifacts after upscaling.
